title: Separate connector runtime from durable business orchestration
problem: Normalize Scout proposal ACR-02-001 for owner reconciliation.
proposed_change: Define connector OAuth/sync responsibility separately from business workflow responsibility. Runtime selection remains with module owners; Temporal/Nango are candidates only.
alternatives: Defer adoption until affected owners supply contract and verification evidence.
contract_impact: Proposed only; no accepted vendor or module boundary change.
security_impact: Candidate discovery is not authorization, commercial clearance, or runtime security verification.
cost_schedule_impact: Removes misrouted work; no paid service is purchased by this proposal.
migration: Apply only through reviewed owner contracts.
rollback: Keep current draft boundaries until proposal is accepted or superseded.
decision_owner: Control Tower with affected module owners
